name: Art of the Steal
note: Every chest is locked: beat a tense lock minigame, pick pockets, and build Merchant Tents that trade for Gold Pieces.
use: Aim at a locked chest, press E. Space or W strikes, R auto, Q/E swap picks. F picks pockets. Tents: build menu, Construction 5.

name: Astral Companions
note: Up to ten Astral Companions: Workers, Warrior, Barbarian, Mages, Archer and Bounty Hunter. They follow, fight, gather, level up.
use: Craft an Astral Worker Scroll at the Crafting Table and read it. E (or G) talks to a companion. Read the Summoning Scroll to command.

name: Cape Effects (The Capes of Wild Dragons)
note: Every cape gets a real power: class capes boost full armour sets, skillcapes multiply yields, Gilded Paladin saves your life.
use: No keys: just wear a cape. Its item card shows what it does. With RuneSchema you can also craft the Gilded Paladin cape.

name: Champion of the Gods
note: Win the favour of ten gods: raise their shrines, pray for blessings, beat each god's trial, then trade with the gods.
use: Talk to Brother Aldwin at the Temple Woods chapel for shrine plans. Build: General > God Shrines. G opens a shrine.

name: Character Origins
note: Postie Pete greets every new character: pick a past, a discipline, a Birth Rune and traits, then grow your Devotion.
use: Talk to Postie Pete (E, or G). Z = Technique, V = second path Technique, X = Birth Rune power. Review: Esc > CHARACTER ORIGINS.

name: Custom World Edits for All
note: Every Custom-mode world setting for any world: build anywhere, unlock recipes, tune damage, XP and enemies. No restart.
use: Esc > MODS > Custom World Edits for All. Flip switches or turn on a slider group. One button puts your world's own values back.

name: Dynamic Display Enhancements
note: Photo-editor look for the whole game: light and colour sliders, 16 filters, presets, day cycles, background blur, telescope.
use: Esc > DYNAMIC DISPLAY ENHANCEMENTS. Hold + / - to zoom the telescope. Shift or Alt + arrow keys move the camera.

name: Elemental Totems
note: Fire, Water, Earth and Air Protection Totems that blast enemies with staff attacks, plus a Lightning Rod that calls lightning.
use: Build: Furniture > Elemental Totems. E turns a totem on or off, F fuels it with its runes. F fuels a Lightning Rod with Nature Runes.

name: Enemies Re-Ignited: Wilds of Ashenfall
note: A living Ashenfall: about 700 creature spots, day and night spawns, rare finds, a mini boss per zone. Most enemies wait until hit.
use: No keys. Settings: Esc > MODS > Enemies Re-Ignited (or config.txt). World settings moved to Custom World Edits.

name: Game Dump
note: Modder tool: dumps every game class and function (Lua types and SDK) once per new game build.
use: Runs by itself at the main menu after a game update. Ctrl+F12 in a world, or the console command gamedump, dumps now.

name: JAQLO - Journal Achievement Quest Log Overhaul
note: Your guide inside the game's Journal and Map: achievements, notes, quest walkthroughs, a map legend, markers and more.
use: Esc > JAQLO or Num +. Map: L opens the legend, T twice on a quest teleports. F7 twice on a bag item scraps the stack.

name: Living Wilds Audio
note: A full remix of the game's own sounds: loud footsteps, punchy hits, a living world, surround bass and Sneak Listening.
use: No keys. Settings > Audio > Living Wilds Audio, or Esc > MODS. First start boots with Music and Sound at 0: turn them up.

name: Penguin Assassin
note: The Penguin outfit becomes an assassin set: Agility-scaled Defence, faster sneaking, parry crits and a poison cape.
use: No keys: wear the Penguin Helmet, Body, Legs and Cape. Item cards show the bonuses. Crouch for the cape's aura.

name: Perks of Ashenfall
note: A full RPG class and perk system: 137 perks over 4 classes, 12 masteries and the Trades, bought with Perk Points.
use: Shift+L opens the class wheel and perk trees. Settings: Esc > MODS (Mod Menu, optional) or config.txt.

name: Portable Chests - Outfit Swap and Auto-Sort
note: Chests you carry: Set Chests swap whole outfits, Auto-Sort Chests store what you gather and work as linked storage.
use: Craft at the Workbench (Auto-Sort & Set Chests, 6 Ash Logs). Open one from your pack to manage it, or from the hotbar to use it.

name: RS Spawner
note: Spawn any of 120 creatures, mini bosses, dragons or bosses. They stay calm until you attack them.
use: Esc > SPAWNER. Pick a tab, set Amount and Level, click a name. Remove Nearest or Remove All cleans up.

name: Relic Hunter UI
note: SkyUI-style inventory with an RS3 look: buffs, skills, sort, stacks of 99, action bars, a Spell Book. Enemies freeze in menus.
use: F9 Hotbar Setup, P Spell Book, F3 hide HUD, 1-8 use your bars (Alt + wheel pages), C sort, G combine. Esc > MODS page.

name: Relic's PhotoMode
note: Photo mode that freezes time: free camera, lens and pose controls, filters, RuneScape frames, stickers and your own text.
use: Esc > PHOTO MODE, or F8 for an instant freeze frame. WASD flies, I hides the menu, F12 takes a Steam screenshot.
